set.body:
The fixed matched performance court found 5.16 MB/op for a 96 x 64 observation-correlation public call and 61.17 MB/op for a 16-support predictive frame, despite strong relational-kernel timing. Profile scientific-plan/result identity construction, pair-axis construction, receipt rebuilding, and repeated per-measurement source/design work. Acceptance: materially reduce allocation without stale identity caching, hidden materialization, weakened receipts, or a second facade.

Sequential assessment 2026-09-12: retain core-performance, reprioritize to P2 until the relevant public workload is reproduced. The reported 5.16/61.17 MB/op workloads describe identified-evidence scientific-plan/pair-axis/receipt construction, whose APIs are absent from current main. Current MvpaEngine.run/runSource returns MvpaResult with RoiOutcome values. Identified-evidence candidates are located in 574db30/4f079da (not ancestors of HEAD), but no current-main measurement establishing these byte counts was produced. Preserve the historical measurements; do not treat them as current-main allocation or prove a speedup by comparing different APIs/estimands.

Refined first deliverable: name the exact current/adopted revision, provider pins, executable public entrypoint, fixed data/identity dimensions, output-retention boundary and allocation counter. Reproduce complete-call allocations with warm-up and consumed outputs; separate construction, preparation, kernel and result phases without omitting any from the end-to-end total. State JVM versus JS measurement limitations and retain comparable whole-call and independent numerical/identity checks.

Only then prioritize repairs by measured cost: reuse immutable preparation/identity where the owner and lifetime authorize it, avoid repeated materialization, and test same-shape foreign/reordered inputs against stale-cache reuse. Do not weaken receipts or build a second facade to hit a kernel-only benchmark. The fit fallback-status issue bd-01M1WVPJ9MMPFDXAY5196E73D7 has been repaired separately and is not evidence that this MVPA task is complete. P1 run/group identity and scientific correctness take precedence. No profiling, performance improvement or source change is claimed by this assessment.
set.title: Re-establish and reduce whole-call MVPA allocation on the adopted API
